Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the WebSurfer’s results and incorrectly asserted that Antonio Vivaldi’s birthplace was Vienna (confusing it with his place of death), contradicting the just-retrieved sources that stated Venice. This led to selecting a Vienna bridge (Reichsbrücke) instead of the correct Venetian landmark (Rialto Bridge).
